items.title: The $2.85B Binance hackers lost shows why the UK needs stablecoin freeze rules
items.summary: The Binance hack proved stablecoin freezes work. Now the UK should make clear freeze rules a condition of listing coins.

items.title: NEAR AI says SGLang vulnerability exposed user account details in security breach
items.summary: NEAR AI explained that it found no indication that stored Private Chat conversations or uploaded files were accessed.

items.title: Will stablecoins survive once the banks catch up?
items.summary: As crypto firms and banks converge, it is fair to ask what lasting advantage stablecoins have, argues Alessandro Hatami, founder of Pacemakers and former COO of Digital Banking at Lloyds Banking Group.

items.title: Solana Set for Another Tokenized Stock Venue as Formation Notifies the SEC
items.summary: Operating under the SEC’s “Innovation Exemption,” the firm plans to list tokenized shares of Exodus, Forward Industries, and Galaxy Digital in early 2027, with the same voting and dividend rights as real stock.

items.title: Goldman Sachs, Citi among banks said to commit $270 million to stablecoin venture
items.summary: The venture, known as Project Faro, plans to issue a dollar-denominated stablecoin and is expected to be incorporated in the U.S.
